name: Frank J Hanna Iii
current_role: CEO, Hanna Capital LLC (Atlanta); major shareholder of Atlanticus Holdings (ATLC)
profile: Atlanta entrepreneur, merchant banker and Catholic philanthropist. A former Troutman Sanders corporate attorney, he and brother David devised a methodology for valuing loan portfolios and built firms around it; David is chairman/CEO of Atlanticus, in which Frank holds a large stake. CEO of Hanna Capital since 2006, investing in technology and financial services.
interesting_fact: Through his Solidarity Association he acquired the Hanna Papyrus I (Bodmer Papyri XIV-XV, c.175-225 AD), containing the oldest known text of the Lord's Prayer, and presented it to Pope Benedict XVI in 2007; it is kept in the Vatican Library.
deep_cut_fact: Was a Foundation Fellow and Truman Scholar at the University of Georgia; in 2002 President George W. Bush named him co-chair of the President's Advisory Commission on Educational Excellence for Hispanic Americans. Author of 'What Your Money Means' (2008) and 'A Graduate's Guide to Life' (2017).
notes: Featured in PBS/Acton documentary 'The Call of the Entrepreneur'. Hanna Capital contact page invites inquiries consistent with its investment or philanthropic approach.

name: Li Jianbo
current_role: Chairman, controlling shareholder and actual controller, Luoyang Jalon Micro-Nano New Materials Co. (SSE STAR: 688357)
profile: Founder (1998) and chairman of Luoyang Jalon Micro-Nano New Materials, formerly Luoyang Jianlong Chemical, a maker of molecular-sieve adsorbents and catalysts for industrial gas separation, medical oxygen, energy/petrochemicals and environmental uses. He and Li Xiaohong are the company's actual controllers; in July 2026 he proposed a share buyback for employee incentives.
interesting_fact: Jalon makes molecular-sieve powders, molded and special sieves and activated alumina used in industrial gas separation, medical oxygen, energy/petrochemicals and renewable energy.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Jalon he spent over a decade (Nov 1987 to Jun 1998) as sales section chief at the Yanshi Donggu water-glass (sodium silicate) factory in Henan.
notes: Company also romanized as Jianlong/Jianlon. For IR contact, consult the company's SSE annual report (board secretary). Molecular sieves for oxygen/gas separation could be an energy-adjacent angle. Company profile lists Li Yicheng as vice chairman/president.
